style: Say brightly and clearly, like an upbeat guide showing a class around a farm.
lines: Welcome to the farm! Let's push and pull. Tap Go to give the ball a push.
The flag shows where it stopped. Now tap Big, then tap Go.
A bigger push sent it farther!
Tap To the gate, then tap Go.
Jo pushed from the other side, so it went the other way!
A wagon has a handle. Tap Pull, then tap Go.
A pull brings the wagon toward Jo. A push sends it away.
The pumpkin is heavy, so the same push moves it less.
Tap Find out to test pushes like a scientist.
Which ball will go farther: the one with a small push, or the one with a big push? Say your guess, then tap a picture.
Does a different push change how far the pumpkin goes? Say your guess, then tap a picture.
Tap Go for try one.
Tap Go for try two.
Tap the ball that went farther.
Tap the pumpkin that went farther.
Yes! That one went farther.
Look again. Count the dots to each flag. Then tap the one that went farther.
The big push sent the ball farther!
The big push sent the pumpkin farther!
Just like we thought!
A surprise! Now we know.
Try one is the pumpkin with a small push. Tap the try two that changes only the push.
Try one is the pumpkin with a big push. Tap the try two that changes only the push.
We changed the push and the thing we pushed. We can't tell which one made the difference! Tap the other try two.
Only the push changed. That's fair! Tap Go.
Jo pushes the wagon to the barn. Tap Go.
Now Jo is on the other side. Which way will the wagon go? Tap a picture.
Jo pushed from the other side, so the wagon went the other way!
Jo pushes the wagon to the barn again. Tap Go.
Now Jo holds the handle and pulls. Which way will the wagon go? Tap a picture.
The pull brought the wagon toward Jo. A push sends things away. A pull brings them close.
Here comes the ball! Jo steps out of the way. Tap Go.
This time Jo gives the rolling ball a small push back. What will happen? Tap a picture.
Jo's push stopped the ball! A push can stop something that is moving.
Tap Next.
We found out! A bigger push sends things farther. A push from the other side sends them the other way. A pull brings them close. And a push can stop a rolling ball.
Tap Barn to help the ball get into the barn.
Jo can only give the ball a small push. Can we get it into the barn? First, tap Roll and watch.
We need the ball to go faster.
Did it work? Tap Yes or Not yet.
Did the buckets fall? Tap Yes or Not yet.
Yes! It worked!
Right, not yet.
Look where the ball is. It didn't work yet.
Look! It did work!
It stopped before the barn.
Rolling up the ramp slowed it down.
It bumped the bale and rolled back.
It turned, but it hit the barn wall.
It turned the wrong way, into the pumpkins.
Splash! It rolled into the pond.
The buckets wobbled, but they didn't fall. The ball was too slow.
It rolled right past the barn, into the hay.
Change our design. Tap a piece, then tap a glowing spot. Then tap Roll.
Change something, then tap Roll.
Watch both balls. The faded one has no ramp. Did the ramp make the ball go faster or slower? Tap a picture.
Faster! The ramp made the ball go faster.
Look again. The ramp ball got ahead. The ramp made it go faster.
Now the barn is up here, and the pond is down the path. Tap Roll and watch where the ball goes.
We need the ball to turn into the barn.
Watch both balls. What did the board change: which way the ball went, or how fast? Tap a picture.
Yes! The board turned the ball. It changed which way it went.
Look again. The board turned the ball. It changed which way it went.
Last one! Knock down the buckets in the barn. Jo's push is small again. Tap Roll and watch.
We need the ball to go faster, and to turn.
We did it! The ramp made the ball faster, and the board turned it. Our design works!
Small push. Big push. Same. Tap a picture.
Farther. Not as far. Same. Tap a picture.
To the barn. To the gate. Stays still. Tap a picture.
Toward Jo. Away from Jo. Stays still. Tap a picture.
Keeps going. Stops. Goes back. Tap a picture.
Tap Roll to try our design.
The piece is back in the tray. Tap a piece, then a glowing spot.
The flags are cleared. Tap Go for another push.
Ball. Tap Go to give it a push.
Pumpkin. Tap Go to give it a push.
Small. Tap Go.
Medium. Tap Go.
Big. Tap Go.
To the barn. Tap Go.
To the gate. Tap Go.
Pull. Tap Go.
Ramp. Tap a glowing spot.
Bale. Tap a glowing spot.
Board up. Tap a glowing spot.
Board down. Tap a glowing spot.
Our tests are on the barn wall. Tap a card to try that test again, or tap Barn.

We think: big push.
We think: same.
We think: farther.
We think: not as far.
We think: to the barn.
We think: to the gate.
We think: stays still.
